sections.text:
Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:
 Forced Draft Fan Double Inlet
73TVAFG
Westinghouse Sturtevant Division USA
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be carried 
 out every three months as indicated by M3 
 in the title block.

The forced draft 
 fan function: pushing atmospheric air through the air preheater dampers through 
 various air ducts and burners into the furnace.

These fans are 
 installed upstream of boiler to supply the required amount of air for 
 combustion,

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Emad El din Ali, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by 
 EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control 
 eng. Samir Abd El- Gelil, 
approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head 
Sector of 
 Abu Soltan Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control head sector.
Technical Specification
Safety Precautions

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is requires,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the 
 forced draft fan.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set

Cleaning Fluid Feeler gauge, anti dust 
 mask
Suitable lifting device.

sections.text:
Work to be Carried 
Out

Before Isolating the 
Forced Draft Fan Mechanically and Electrically

items: Measure the vibration (3: 6 Mils)

Listen and check any 
 abnormal Noise.

Check the Lubrication oil Level in 
front and rear bearing housing

Check the Temperature of rear and 
front bearing
800 oF
Check any leakage of oil Lubrication from front or rear bearing.

Check any leakage of water 
 cooling from front or rear bearing.

Read and check the quantity of air 
according lead.

Check any oil leakage from 
 dust seal.

sections.text: After Isolating the Forced Draft Fan Mechanically and Electrically
Check the front / rear bearing and replace the defect bearing.
Check the shaft seals and replace it if needed.
Dismantle the safety cover of the coupling .
Check any leakage from o-rings or gasket

Check gap with feeler for hob separation at 905C 
 points = 1/8 ".

Check hubs alignment with straight edges 905C 
 points
Lubricant hub and sleeve teeth with new grease before cleaning all parts
Check the alignment of the coupling half's and re-alignment it if needed.
Clean the pipes of water cooling by opening the drains.
Check and clean the check valve of water cooling.
Check and retighten all bolts.
Check every part well.

After successful inspection, operate the fan again 
read all available record values and put them in table (2) and compare between the 
values before and after inspection
